parameters.name: swc_dir
parameters.description: Physical-space reconstructions, i.e. <asset>/refinement/final-world. Not final-voxel: voxel coordinates are rejected.

parameters.name: processed_dataset
parameters.description: Optional. Processed imaging dataset: name, s3:// URI, or subject id. Resolved through DocDB first; if that fails, the image recorded in the reconstructions' refinement/data_process.json is used.

parameters.name: experimenters
parameters.description: Comma-separated names recorded on this stage

parameters.name: allow_no_displacement_field
parameters.description: Set to True to transform without a manual CCF refinement when none exists. Otherwise the run fails if <dataset>/manual_ccf_refinement/ has no .nrrd.
